messages.subject: 'mrds' ver 2.1.15 correct citation
parts:
Hello group,

I have used the 'mrds' package ver. 2.1.15 to generate a probability density plot superimposed over a histogram of radial distances (package downloaded via DistanceDevelopment/mrds on GitHub). I would like to ensure that I cite this newest version of the package properly and a year is not being shown with citation(package="mrds"). So, I'm not sure which year to label it with (2015? 2016?).

Thanks for any advice,
Sara Williams
